author: Jeff Geerling
description:
The Special Value Pi 4 was only for sale for a week. Right after I bought one, it was gone! What made it a 'special value', anyway?

Here's where I first heard about these 'Special Value' Pi 4s: https://www.cnx-software.com/2026/06/26/discounted-1-25-ghz-raspberry-pi-4-model-b/
